context: Two execs discuss naming the new subsidiary
purpose: Teach: 集会/拡張/名称/同盟/関与/提携/損失/連中

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 昨日の集会で、新しい子会社の名称について意見が割れたな。
lines.en: At yesterday's meeting, opinions split over the new subsidiary's name.
lines.style: Gruff executive tone, slightly tired and reflective after a long board session.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい。事業拡張のタイミングですし、海外にも通じる名前が望ましいかと。
lines.en: Yes. With the business expansion timing, a name that works overseas would be ideal.
lines.style: Polite, measured office-lady speech with careful keigo and a forward-looking tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うむ。だが、あの連中はやたら横文字を嫌うんだ。
lines.en: Mm. But those guys really hate foreign-loanword names.
lines.style: Blunt and a bit dismissive, lowering his voice when referring to other executives.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: それでしたら、提携先のブランドイメージにも合う和名を提案できます。
lines.en: In that case, I can suggest a Japanese name that matches our partner's brand image.
lines.style: Professional and proactive, offering a tactful compromise with respectful phrasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 提携といえば、ABC社との同盟関係はどこまで関与させる予定だ?
lines.en: Speaking of partnerships, how far do we plan to involve ABC in this alliance?
lines.style: Probing, businesslike, leaning forward with sharper executive curiosity.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資本は入れず、技術協力のみです。深入りすれば損失リスクも高まりますので。
lines.en: No capital, only technical cooperation. Going deeper would raise the risk of losses.
lines.style: Crisp and analytical, citing risk with calm boardroom confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 賢明だな。では名称は明日の役員会で正式に決めよう。
lines.en: Wise. Then let's formally decide the name at tomorrow's board meeting.
lines.style: Decisive closing tone, voice firming as he settles the matter.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。候補を三つほどまとめて、朝までにお持ちします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare about three candidates and bring them by morning.
lines.style: Reliable, polished sign-off with quiet determination and a slight bow in voice.
